------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Krishna Murari, Advocate  : Mr. Raj Vardhan, Advocate

For the State : Mrs. Nehala Sharmin, Spl. P.P.
 ------
 Order No.05 Dated- 19.05.2023  Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Vigilance Case No. 62 of 2017 corresponding to Ranchi Sadar Vigilance P. S. Case No. 7 of 2015 instituted under Sections 406, 409, 419, 420, 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(c)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privileges of anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Ranchi Sadar Vigilance P. S. Case No. 7 of 2015
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the allegation against the petitioner is that he being an Executive Engineer of Zila Parishad, Chaibasa was involved in construction of a road but the grade (size) of the metal used in the said road was not within specified range and the aggregate impact value of the metal was also not found as per the norms specified by the Ministry of Shipping, Road Transport and Highways.

entities.text: Ministry of Shipping, Road Transport and Highways
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is next submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that for the selfsame allegation, an FIR was lodged vide Jeraikella P. S. Case No. 11 of 2011 corresponding to G. R. No. 305 of 2011.

entities.text: Jeraikella P. S. Case No. 11 of 2011
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the petitioner is ready and willing to deposit Rs.1,00,000/- with the Deputy Commissioner, West Singhbhum at Chaibasa without prejudice to the interest of this case and subject to the final decision of this case.

It is next submitted that since charge-sheet has already been submitted and petitioner all along cooperated in the investigation of the case hence police did not feel necessary to arrest him during the investigation therefore, no fruitful purpose would be served by denying the privilege of anticipatory Bashishtha Narayan Pandey @ Bashist ... vs The State Of Jharkhand Through ... on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171150766/
1 bail to the petitioner.

entities.text: Bashishtha Narayan Pandey @ Bashist ... vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is lastly submitted that the co-accused person has already been given the privilege of anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 05.11.2019, passed in A.B.A. No. 5311 of 2019.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be also given the privileges of anticipatory bail on the principle of parity.
Learned A.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering the submissions of learned counsels and the facts and circumstances stated above, I am inclined to grant privileges of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court of learned Special Judge (ACB), Chaibasa within eight weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on showing the proof of deposit of Rs.1,00,000/- with the Deputy Commissioner, West Singhbhum at Chaibasa and on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge (A.C.B.), Chaibasa in connection with Vigilance Case No. 62 of 2017 corresponding to Ranchi Sadar Vigilance P. S. Case No. 7 of 2015 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
